usage: Usually means business, trade, or commerce; in everyday Cantonese, it most often refers to doing business, running a shop, or a line of business.
Common with verbs like 做、搞、做開, and with words like 生意人, 生意額, 生意差, 生意好; it feels very natural in workplace and money-related talk.
Can also mean a business deal or a customer relationship, so it is not only about big companies; small shops and family businesses use it a lot.
Neutral to informal in Hong Kong Cantonese; very common in speech and writing, and easy to use when talking about work, shops, sales, and business performance.
